question: What extraordinary powers arise from this stage of yogic accomplishment?
premises: Knowledge of hearing from a distance is attained
The power to paralyze bonds is likewise attained
These are presented as resulting accomplishments
inference: This stage yields the powers of distant hearing and the paralysis of bonds
uncertainties: The precise nature of pāśa-stobha may refer to immobilizing fetters or enemies
plain_english: O beloved, one gains knowledge of distant hearing and likewise the power to paralyze bonds.
